name: Woodgrain 55
notes: Wood grain running round a knot, smoke curl: a scale-free wedge rather than a ring, so the grain has fine and coarse lines together instead of one thread width, then warped so it flows. TONAL dual-gate: the mask is the tone-mapped field itself, so the stroke carries the texture as graded alpha and the level number is the damage/modulation DEPTH. Rides the SHALLOW RIGID train (dual scatter 0.2, spacing 0.28, n=3) because the warp makes its curves PHASE structure, and a deep train averages independent windows and blends curves away. Measured both ways on this family: three-quarters more delivered contrast on the rigid train at equal ripple (docs/spectral-atlas.md §4). tonal.gain 1.7 is the shallower train's compensation. Tip from tips/woodgrain.spec.json; audited by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. Dual spacing 0.14, not the rigid-train default 0.28: this spectrum sat on the train's count staircase and the residual line needed the deeper overlap.
